# Colord notice provenance

`@pixi/colord@2.9.6` declares MIT and identifies the upstream project as `omgovich/colord`, but its npm artifact does not include the license text. `LICENSE.md` preserves the upstream file at commit `0d16e3b7ab0a4bcb42e6682712cc124af5f7ce9d` (2021-04-07).

Source: https://github.com/omgovich/colord/blob/0d16e3b7ab0a4bcb42e6682712cc124af5f7ce9d/LICENSE.md

Recheck provenance and packaged notices when upgrading PixiJS or Colord.
